description: This file implements the PooledSharedImageVideoProvider class and related classes for managing pooled images and requests in a media GPU context, including image creation, pooling, and synchronization handling.

classes.name: PooledSharedImageVideoProvider
classes.description: Main class managing pooled images, requests, and synchronization for video images in GPU context.

classes.name: PooledSharedImage
classes.description: Represents a pooled image with its specification and record.

classes.name: PendingRequest
classes.description: Represents a pending image request with its specification and callback.

classes.name: GpuHelperImpl
classes.description: Helper class for GPU-related operations, including handling sync tokens and notifying image usage.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of PooledSharedImageVideoProvider.

methods.name: RequestImage
methods.description: Requests an image with a specific specification and callback.

methods.name: OnImageCreated
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new image record.

methods.name: OnImageReturned
methods.description: Handles the return of an image, waiting for sync token clearance.

methods.name: ProcessFreePooledImage
methods.description: Processes a pooled image, fulfilling requests or pooling it.
